text.opengl: Write learnopengl's ResourceManager as two global maps and free functions – `LoadShader` / `GetShader`, `LoadTexture` / `GetTexture`, `ClearResources` – with the helpers `loadShaderFromFile` (std::ifstream) and `loadTextureFromFile` (stb_image); call `ClearResources()` before `glfwTerminate()`.
text.vulkan: Write learnopengl's ResourceManager: the global maps `Shaders` (name → pipeline) and `Textures`, the free functions `GetShader` / `GetTexture`, and the members `LoadShader`, `LoadTexture` and `ClearResources`; call `ClearResources()` in `cleanup()`.
text.d3d12: Write learnopengl's ResourceManager as two global maps and free functions – `LoadShader` / `GetShader`, `LoadTexture` / `GetTexture`, `ClearResources` – with the helpers `loadShaderFromFile` (D3DCompileFromFile of VSMain and PSMain) and `loadTextureFromFile` (stb_image); call `ClearResources()` in `OnDestroy`.

hint.opengl: `std::map<std::string, Shader> Shaders; std::map<std::string, Texture2D> Textures;`. `loadTextureFromFile`: `glGenTextures(1, &texture.ID)`, GL_RGBA formats if `alpha`, `stbi_load(file, &width, &height, &nrChannels, 0)`, `Generate`, `stbi_image_free`. `GetShader` / `GetTexture` return a reference to the stored object.
hint.vulkan: `LoadShader(vShaderFile, fShaderFile, name)`: `createPipeline(vShaderFile, fShaderFile, Shaders[name]);` – the "shader" is the pipeline. `LoadTexture(file, name)`: `Textures[name] = loadTextureFromFile(file);`. `ClearResources()`: `vkDestroyPipeline` for each pipeline, `vkDestroyImageView`, `vkDestroyImage`, `vkFreeMemory` for each texture (the descriptor sets go with the pool).
hint.d3d12: A texture's ID is the next free heap slot: `texture.ID = Graphics.SrvCount++;`, then `stbi_load(file, &width, &height, &nrChannels, 4)`. `D3DCompileFromFile(shaderFile, nullptr, nullptr, "VSMain", "vs_5_0", …)` and `"PSMain", "ps_5_0"`; on failure print the error blob with `OutputDebugStringA` and throw. `ClearResources()`: `Shaders.clear(); Textures.clear();`, after `WaitForPreviousFrame()` in `OnDestroy`.
